FormsBlank: This is the form itself — exactly what everyone who follows your link opens. Upload a PDF form you already have, or build one from the template gallery without leaving the workspace.
FormsComplete: A submitted copy lands in {{complete}} and stays there, one per person. Switch on result collection and every answer also becomes a row in a spreadsheet — one column per field, ready to sort or chart.
FormsCreateFirst: Create a form space, drop your PDF form into it and send the link out. The first answers can be in before the end of the day.
FormsEmpty: The spaces you have just seen were a preview. A form space appears in this list as soon as someone invites you to fill a form in, and the form is waiting for you inside it.
FormsEmptyTitle: Your list is empty for now
FormsInProgress: The moment someone opens the form they get a copy of their own, saved into {{inProgress}} as they type — nothing is lost if they close the tab, and nothing counts as an answer until they submit. Anyone you invite as {{formFiller}} sees only their own copy, never anyone else's.
FormsItem: Every row is a whole collection. Open one to work inside it, pin the ones you are running, or use the three dots to invite people, copy the link that opens the form, and save the setup as a template.
FormsOpenSpace: Let's open this one and see how a collection is put together. Inside every form space are the same three things: the form itself, the answers still being written, and the ones already in.
FormsPlacesRecent: {{recent}} and {{favorites}} keep the collections you are running at hand.
FormsPlacesTemplates: {{templates}} — the form space templates you saved.
FormsPlacesTrash: {{trash}} — deleted form spaces, restorable until you empty it.
FormsSpace: A form space is one collection from end to end: the blank PDF form, the people filling it in, and every answer that comes back. Let's create one and look inside.
FormsTemplates: Collecting the same form every quarter? Save the space as a template — the form, the roles, the tags and the result settings are kept. The next round starts in one click.
